answer: In an agent economy%2C sybil attacks can be resisted by requiring each agent to maintain a unique activity mesa where it must periodically deposit a small bond into a shared vault and generate a non-parallelizable echo of sequential work proofs. If the agent fails to produce consistent unique signals over time%2C its standing falls to the nadir%2C causing the bond to be burned and preventing mass cloning of identities without proportional resource expenditure.
